news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Odell Beckham Jr. to be elevated by Vikings Sunday
news.desc: The Vikings will elevate WR Odell Beckham Jr. from their practice squad for Sunday's game against the Saints.
news.impact: Beckham signed with Minnesota earlier this week. He will remain off the fantasy radar.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Darius Slayton (knee) ruled out Sunday
news.desc: Darius Slayton has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Steelers.
news.impact: Slayton had been listed as questionable. His absence won't impact the Colts offense for fantasy managers.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Marvin Harrison Jr: Cardinals finalizing trade
news.desc: The Cardinals are finalizing a deal to trade WR Marvin Harrison Jr.
news.impact: The Cardinals informed Harrison this morning that he will be inactive for Sunday's game against the Lions as the details of the trade are finalized. It remains unclear as of now where he will be traded.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) plans to play Sunday, to see how he feels Saturday
news.desc: ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports that Justin Jefferson plans to play in Week 5 against the Saints, but the team "has to see how he feels on Saturday."
news.impact: We should know by the end of Saturday if Jefferson will be good to go on Sunday. He will be a WR1 play if he is good to go.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Jayden Daniels (elbow) still not '100 percent' healthy
news.desc: NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reports that Jayden Daniels is not "100 percent" healthy yet.
news.impact: Daniels is still slated to play on Sunday against the Giants, but re-injury risk is a bit of a concern.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Tyler Guyton (back) not dealing with serious injury
news.desc: Cowboys coach Brian Schottenheimer said LT Tyler Guyton's back injury is not considered serious.
news.impact: Guyton left Thursday's game late. He is day-to-day heading into next week.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Nick Bosa (knee/calf) to likely return in Week 6
news.desc: Nick Bosa told reporters it is "pretty darn likely" he plays in Week 6 against the Commanders.
news.impact: Bosa will miss his third straight game on Sunday. He should be back next week.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Zach Charbonnet (knee) uncertain for Week 6
news.desc: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Seattle's Week 6 Thursday Night Football game against the Broncos makes Zach Charbonnet's ramp-up "tricky."
news.impact: Charbonnet has been limited since returning to practice, but a short week in Week 6 makes a return then tricky. It sounds like Week 7 against the Chiefs is more likely when he returns.

news.author: Ari Koslow
news.title: Lamar Jackson (ankle) uncertain for Week 6
news.desc: The Ravens reportedly "do not know" whether Lamar Jackson will play in Week 6 against the Browns.
news.impact: Jackson remains week-to-week after he was ruled out for this Sunday. Tyler Huntley could be seeing more than one start.

news.author: Garrett Ball
news.title: Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST contain Cowboys in win
news.desc: The Tampa Bay Buccaneers D/ST racked up two interceptions and a fumble recovery in the Buccaneers' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday.
news.impact: The Bucs' defense was pliable on the Cowboys' first drive of the game, but stiffened significantly after that. They did give up a touchdown in the fourth quarter, but managed to make a crucial interception when Dallas was attempting to force overtime. It was a much better showing than we previously had seen from Tampa's defense, but don't call it a comeback just yet.
